load_archive_file: download and extract a tar archive file from a URL or local path into the cache directory
cached_path: resolve a URL or local file path and return the cached local file path after downloading if needed
get_from_cache: download a file from an HTTP or S3 URL into the local cache directory and return the cached path
read_set_from_file: read a text file line by line and return a deduplicated set of strings from the file
url_to_filename: convert a URL string into a repeatable SHA256 hashed filename optionally including an etag
